`src/flask/cli.py`

The runner imports the module, then `find_best_app` looks for a `Flask` instance named `app` or `application`, then any single `Flask` instance in the module, and finally calls a `create_app` or `make_app` function with no arguments. When an explicit `module:name` is given, `find_app_by_string` parses the name and calls it with literal arguments if it is a function.

`src/flask/cli.py`
